newsitem.title: USA: ShopKo sees retail, ProVantage sales growth.
newsitem.headline: ShopKo sees retail, ProVantage sales growth.

text.p: ShopKo Stores Inc said it expects retail same-store sales to grow four to six percent in fiscal 1998.

Chief executive officer Dale Kramer also said sales from the ProVantage healthcare business are expected to rise to $525 million in the fiscal 1998 year compared with $349 million in the year-ago period.
The company made the projections in a telephone conference call to discuss fiscal fourth quarter and fiscal 1997 earnings released earlier.
